name: omnilab/usgs-water
description: Omnilab USGS Water: the USGS's water data through the Water Data OGC APIs (which replace the WaterServices) - a monitoring location's series (discharge, gage height, water temperature, any parameter by its USGS code) as recorded every 5 or 15 minutes, hourly, or as the USGS's daily statistics, at a station named or the nearest one of a point; a monitoring location as an entity with its place, drainage area and the series it keeps; the locations by name. No key needed; an api.data.gov key raises the rate limit.
